propositions: Four deterministic, read-only metric functions must derive code-health metrics from git history and the working tree: module_size_distribution, cap_change_events, churn, and refactor_to_addition_ratio.
module_size_distribution scans src/rebar/**/*.py line counts against a single-sourced hard cap read from .github/module-size-limit.txt and returns count, near_cap_count, over_cap_count, and max_loc.
cap_change_events and churn extract historical data from git log over a configurable range, returning list[dict] for cap changes and dict{insertions, deletions} for churn.
refactor_to_addition_ratio derives deletions/insertions from numstat and returns None when total insertions is zero (avoiding division by zero).

All four metrics must register in the c085 REGISTRY with lens='code_health', source='git', confidence='high', and accruing_since='2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00', wrapped as single-arg compute adapters that extract range from context.

Unit tests must verify exact return values (module_size_distribution counts, churn totals, refactor_to_addition_ratio ratios, cap_change_events as list) and registration labels via REGISTRY iteration.
